So resolutionCriteria contains a baseline timestamp: "published strictly after <baseline> and at or before <end>". Fix 13's "resolutionCriteria cutoff timestamp" = that baseline ("published strictly after") — evidence fetch/publication must be AFTER the baseline so the facts are in-window for resolution. Baselining: e.g. 2026-11-24T09:06:27Z. Our sources: fetched Nov 26 ✓; but publication dates of sources — e.g. Destatis release Nov 17 (< Nov 24!). Hmm — the resolution criteria refer to the RESOLVER's publication (Bundeskanzlei official result), not to our evidence sources. FIX-LIST #13 says "source fetch/publication timestamp must be AFTER each market's resolutionCriteria cutoff timestamp (stale facts = $0)". If interpretation = source publication after Nov 24 baseline, then Destatis Nov 17 press release FAILS → de-cpi draft rejected... that can't be intended. The practical reading: FETCH time in same run must be after the baseline timestamp — that's automatic (runs now > Nov 24). Also the asOf freshness check (fix 12): "asOf freshness check" — probably candidate.asOf vs cutoff (asOf must be before market evidenceCutoffAt — obviously; and < 2h old / same-run).

I'll implement freshness gate as: (a) every fetched source's fetchedAt must be after the market baseline (parsed from resolutionCriteria "strictly after <ts>") — enforce each doc.fetchedAt > baseline; (b) candidate.asOf within 2h of run now (asOf freshness); (c) fetchedAt < evidenceCutoffAt (a fetch after the evidence cutoff would be evidence taken outside window... actually evidence must be submitted before cutoff; fetching after cutoff shouldn't happen since market filtered by cutoff > 6h). Implement (a)+(b). Additionally parse "at or before <ts>" end to also enforce docs fetched before... no — that's the resolver window.

Note mock mode: doc.fetchedAt = MOCK_NOW (2026-11-26T12:00Z) > baseline Nov 24 ✓.
